ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on outer lobes versus 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central notch region and along the trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) geometric region extending from the notch; multiple discrete black punctate spots on the left lobe; intricate linear black markings on the distal areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle calculated at approximately 75 degrees; vertex contact point with water surface creates slight spray occlusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases significantly toward the distal tips; jagged profile isolated against white/grey background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curvature terminating in acute, slightly recurved tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white/grey protrusions (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered white punctate scars visible within the dark central pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct sets of parallel, low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) on the white surface of the left lobe; multiple intersecting unaligned linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring across both ventral lobes; active barnacle colonization at distal extremities; multiple focal depigmentation spots in the central dark region.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique fan-shaped pattern consisting of four parallel curved black lines on the mid-section of the left lobe.
